$comment: pi sandbox extension allowlist. M1 contract: only hash-pinned path: extensions; the launcher stages the verified bytes and pi loads ONLY the staged copies. npm:/git: pins are rejected until M4 materializes verified artifacts at image build time. See packaging/pi/sandbox/README.md.

unattended-exec.description: Unattended execution child: may read, edit, and drive the anvil state loop. Extension list is empty until M2 publishes the hash-pinned anvil-pi entry point.

read-only-review.description: Fresh-context review child: read-only tools, no network, no write surface.
